study: COMP765 exploratory cross-actor association context pilot
question: Do explicit training-derived cross-actor event associations improve predictions beyond an unchanged scene-GRU student?
baseline: Original frozen ResNet50 through layer3, shared448x672 image features, RoI features/geometry/agent embedding and scene GRU256; original distilled checkpoints seeds0,1,2 selected by supervised development BCE
data: Exact original64 training videos x32frame segments,12 development videos x32frames,198 official validation videos; manifests copied by hash

rule_mining.source: ground truth actors in exact training segments only; IDs remapped via master label strings
rule_mining.transaction: target actor and presence of events on other nearby actors
rule_mining.weight: Each target-agent/video contributes total1, divided across its target actor-frames
rule_mining.effect: logit(shrunk conditional probability)-logit(marginal target probability), clipped[-1,1]

inference.context: Original current-frame predictions only, before correction; detector confidence>=0.25; class-agnostic NMS IoU0.5; at most30context candidates; neighbor and overlap filters identical to mining
inference.evidence: max over eligible other actors of q*semantic probability for each agent-compatible antecedent
inference.frequency_control: Same rule effects and denominator but replace per-frame evidence with training marginal antecedent-presence probabilities conditional on target agent
inference.state: Original GRU reset at video boundary, continuous current/past prefixes; postprocessor stateless

selection.objective: Mean across3seeds of development triplet proposal AP over supported classes; independent common lambda for association and frequency; ties within1e-10 select smaller lambda
selection.checkpoint_selection: Unchanged historical BCE-selected checkpoint; no retraining or new checkpoint choice

evaluation.primary: Paired association-minus-baseline overall triplet detector mAP
evaluation.tail: Existing training-derived86class standardized log10 frequency; fixed manifest
evaluation.statistics: Individual seeds, mean/sampleSD,paired differences,95%paired-t interval df2,t4.30265273; descriptive only3seeds
evaluation.reuse_caveat: Official validation benchmark has prior research use and detector checkpoint selection exposure. This is exploratory, not an untouched test. Student development videos overlap teacher historical development.

freeze: Protocol before mining/new development results; code,rules,chosen strengths and source hashes before official AP. No final-AP tuning.
limitations: Tests incremental postprocessing, not whether GRU internally represents associations
No claim of novel association-rule method
Target-centric overlapping actor-frame transactions are dependent; video support is descriptive, not significance
Rules from short training segments may miss rare events
No teacher, cached teacher features or future frames at inference
No architecture/backbone/GRU/loss changes; original teacher future-window supervision remains historical
